description: This Java source file defines a final class `ShardRegionFactory` responsible for creating and managing Akka cluster sharding regions for different services such as Things, Policies, and Search Updater. It includes methods to obtain shard regions and handles setting up cluster sharding proxies and settings, leveraging constants and utilities specific to the project.

classes.name: ShardRegionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing Akka shard regions for various services, including Things, Policies, and Search Updater. It provides thread-safe singleton access via `getInstance` and methods to initialize specific shard regions with proper configurations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to obtain an instance of ShardRegionFactory for a given ActorSystem, ensuring the ActorSystem parameter is not null.

methods.name: getThingsShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for 'Things' service, given the number of shards. Uses predefined constants for region name and cluster role.

methods.name: getPoliciesShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for 'Policies' service, given the number of shards. Uses respective constants for region name and cluster role.

methods.name: getSearchUpdaterShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for the Search Updater, passing Props, number of shards, and cluster role. Sets up sharding settings with role.

methods.name: createShardRegion
methods.description: Internal helper method to start a shard region or proxy with given parameters using Akka Cluster Sharding.
